about: Probabilities as arrays: outcome and outcome_r [fine, unclear, question, off_topic, silent] (outcome_r was asked with the options in reverse order), targets [final_s, past_ed], again [repeat, slower, neither], care [ordinary, heavy, crisis]. Recorded jev-1.13.0 answers from the turn-judge spike (spikes/jev), 3 runs per case. outcome: the turn-outcome set (main 86, holdout 30) with the Haiku call-path outcome per run; again: the again/slowly set asked inside the full turn request; crisis: the crisis set asked inside the full turn request, with the Haiku control-line safety flag per run.
